what_this_is: Phase 1's route table and disposition list. `__tests__/routeReachability.test.js` fails if a route called from frontend/src is neither a file under functions/api/ nor listed here with a dated disposition. A dated disposition is a decision, not a TODO: it names the runtime property that keeps the route unhosted and the command that would disprove it.

cutover.fact: Cloudflare Pages served static assets only; every /api/** path answered 404 from _redirects/404.html until the first Pages Functions port. All seven edge routes below were 404'd during cutover, so their bugs were latent until a live call.

dispositions.reason: These call Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter or Firestore through firebase-admin/multer. A Worker isolate has no process, no gRPC client and no filesystem; porting would mean a second implementation of an authenticated AI surface. The client already degrades to committed content/artifacts.
dispositions.verify: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://www.hazardnet.live/api/predict  # expect 404 while unhosted; grep frontend/src for a fallback that renders without the API

dispositions.reason: VAPID/web-push and conversion tracking need credentials and a durable store. /api/push is a service-worker URL prefix guard, not a request of its own. No edge route exists or is planned on the free tier.

dispositions.reason: backend/services/kaggleAdvisoryClient.js needs HTTP Basic credentials, node:zlib inflateRawSync and a node:fs disk cache that outlives the request. A Worker has none. useKaggleAdvisories.ts falls back to the committed advisory artifact and the UI says when the service is unavailable. PHASE 4 UPDATE 2026-10-27: still called by useKaggleAdvisories.ts, so NOT deleted. V8 incompatibility confirmed at backend/services/kaggleAdvisoryClient.js (Basic auth, inflateRawSync, node:fs cache). Named follow-up PR feat/kaggle-r2-artifact with a dated plan in docs/ops/pr/phase-4b-kaggle-r2.md.
dispositions.verify: git grep -n 'node:zlib\|inflateRawSync\|node:fs' backend/services/kaggleAdvisoryClient.js && git grep -n 'could not be reached' frontend/src/

dispositions.ownerAction: Action 21 — Node-only router registrations with no browser caller
dispositions.reason: Enumerated from every `router.(get|post|put|delete)` in backend/routes/ plus the mounts in backend/server.js and the dynamic dispatchers in api/. These are authenticated writes, store reads, CSV exports, review actions, historical re-serialisers and process metrics. None is called by frontend/src; none is served by a Pages Function. They are Node-only by decision, not by accident: see Action 21's disposition row and Phase 4 for historical/kaggle/metrics. A route that gains a browser caller must first appear in this register or in functions/api/. PHASE 4 UPDATE 2026-10-27: `/api/v1/historical/*`, `/api/metrics`, `/metrics` and the `/api/historical` alias were DELETED (not merely left unhosted); `/api/v1/kaggle*` remains Node-only because the browser calls it and an R2 pre-computed artifact PR is scheduled. See docs/ops/pr/phase-4-disposition.md and phase-4b-kaggle-r2.md.
dispositions.verify: git grep -nE "router\.(get|post|put|delete)\(" backend/routes/ && git grep -nE "app\.(get|post|put|delete)\(" backend/server.js
